theme.title: Golden State's fourth
theme.subtitle: The 2022 Finals
theme.recap: The Warriors won a fourth title in eight years behind Stephen Curry and a 21–0 run in the clincher.

questions.prompt: With Golden State down 2–1 in the 2022 Finals, how many points did Stephen Curry score in Game 4?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Curry scored 43 points and had 10 rebounds in a 107–97 win to even the series 2–2.

funFacts.text: Curry played through a sore foot after Marcus Smart rolled into him while both chased a loose ball in Game 3.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston's Smart rolled over his foot when they went for a loose ball

funFacts.text: Andrew Wiggins helped win the rebounding battle with a career-best Finals night on the glass.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Andrew Wiggins added 17 points and a career-high 16 rebounds

funFacts.text: Steve Kerr benched Draymond Green at key moments of the fourth quarter in favor of Kevon Looney.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Kerr benched him for parts of the fourth quarter, while Looney remained on the floor

questions.prompt: Steve Kerr's 2022 title was his ninth overall. How many did he win as a player?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Kerr won his ninth championship overall, after winning five as a player.

funFacts.text: Kerr's Warriors had the NBA's worst record only a few seasons before reclaiming the championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors also became the first team to go from the NBA's worst record

funFacts.text: The championship earned Kerr a place among the select coaches to win four NBA titles.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He became the sixth coach to capture four titles

funFacts.text: Kerr's lineup adjustment in Boston temporarily replaced Draymond Green with rebounding specialist Kevon Looney.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Kerr benched him for parts of the fourth quarter, while Looney remained on the floor

questions.prompt: In the 2022 title clincher, Golden State went on an unanswered run of how many points?
questions.note: 21–0, the longest in modern Finals history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 21–0 run was the longest such run in modern Finals history.

funFacts.text: Boston opened the deciding game with a quick surge, but Golden State answered before the first quarter ended.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston took a 14–2 lead to start the game

funFacts.text: The Warriors' swarming defense forced repeated Boston turnovers before halftime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors forced 12 turnovers in the first half

funFacts.text: The Warriors were only the second visiting team to clinch an NBA championship on Boston's floor.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This was the second time that a road team won an NBA championship in Boston

questions.prompt: Jayson Tatum set the record for turnovers in one postseason in 2022. How many?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tatum set the NBA record for most turnovers in a single postseason with 100.

funFacts.text: Tatum's first Finals game was a passing showcase despite a poor shooting night against Golden State.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he finished with a career-high 13 assists, the most ever for a player in his Finals debut

funFacts.text: Boston erased a shaky regular-season start to reach its first NBA Finals in over a decade.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After starting the season 16–19 and in 10th place

funFacts.text: Golden State's defense held Tatum to a rough shooting night in the championship clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tatum finished with 13, shooting just 6-of-18 from the field

questions.prompt: Boston and Golden State set a Finals record for combined threes in Game 1 of 2022. How many?
questions.context: 2022 NBA Finals · Game 1 · at Golden State

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Both teams made a combined 40 three-pointers, the most ever in an NBA Finals game

funFacts.text: Al Horford finally reached his first Finals after years of playoff appearances, then led Boston's scoring in the opener.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After playing 141 playoff games without an NBA Finals appearance

funFacts.text: The Celtics rallied in the fourth quarter after facing a double-digit deficit against the Warriors.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics outscored the Warriors 40–16

funFacts.text: Jayson Tatum struggled to shoot in the opener but set a Finals-debut record for assists.
